In vocal group performances, notably in soul and gospel music, and early rock and roll, the lead singer takes the main vocal part, with a chorus provided by other band members as backing vocalists.

The group is currently gearing up for their first full-length album.

He performed as a bassist and lead singer in bands such as Death Piggy, X-Cops, and the Dave Brockie Experience (DBX), and starred in the comedy/horror TV sitcom "Holliston" as Oderus Urungus.  Brockie died in 2014 of a heroin overdose.
